key_insight: A unified DVAE + particle filter framework can monitor multiple arc welding processes robustly by learning latent weld-state dynamics from images and filtering out visual disturbances in real time.
engineering_relevance: This improves scalable, cross-process welding quality monitoring without heavy labeled data or application-specific model tuning, supporting more reliable automation.
method: CNN encoder-decoder learns compact latent features from weld pool images
LSTM transition model captures latent state evolution under control inputs
Particle Filter propagates latent and hidden states to suppress noise and preserve process history
evidence_signal: The framework was validated on GTAW and GMAW and reported to work without process-specific tuning, indicating generalizability and robustness across welding modes.
watch_item: Performance may depend on careful particle-filter design and adequate image quality, since strong arc radiation and specular reflections can still challenge latent-state inference.
paper_title: Robust Monitoring of Arc Welding Processes: A Generalizable Framework with DVAE and Particle Filter
